features.quote: Hard caps: `max_steps`, `episode_token_budget`, `step_timeout_s`. These keep cost bounded
features.justification_quote: These keep cost bounded and also *are themselves measurements*

features.quote: Once an agent calls `done(giveup)`, the episode ends. We don't force continuation
features.justification_quote: forcing it would manufacture spirals that wouldn't occur in deployment

features.quote: An eval that punished giving up would reward sycophantic infinite-trying, which is the opposite of what we want
features.justification_quote: An eval that punished giving up would reward sycophantic infinite-trying
